translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

book.name: EFESO
book.title: Folo yana leta EFESO tovetumagana agaidiya

content: Keliso buye kaveꞋatutamoꞋaida-yo wayawaida ivaguna
kamimiyami.
Tu omiꞋiyao ma tuwaina omi vaita toꞋalika amine. Yaubada yana vehimeya wadibutoyogena ada dewa koyona againe wahawahegemi faꞋina, aluꞋaluwami vaita aliꞋalikana.

Mena dibutoyoga kadu dewa koyona ana eda againe tuwaina wanunudadana, hida babi ana nuwanuwa koyona amine wadewadewa, kadu Setani badi yafune lobama hinafane hinunudadana-ma adi tovehimeya yana abavehimeya againe wamiyami. Tova adamoya bana kalivai-nadi yana nuwanuwa koyona todibutoyoga aseꞋasediya gifahafahana.

Boi tuwaina ide moyaꞋaida badi todibutoyoga adi yoꞋo kalivadi. Dibuda koyona ana ayafana amine kadewadewa, ada gavaimi gavaimi wowoda o nuwada giludigadigaga, mededemi taudeyao yada nuwanuwa koyona againe kahawahawahegeda. Todibutoyoga moyaꞋaidi yadi koyona faꞋina Yaubada yana ilaꞋa guwana hinanuhagana. Ada tuwaina kadu ide dibuda koyona katubuga-ma kamiyami, ada vaita todibutoyoga moyaꞋaidi amine Yaubada yana ilaꞋa guwana kadanuhagana.

Atu Yaubada ma ana egana tohinekalikali. Yana nuwakabubu ide agaideya keke kabiꞋona faꞋina, Keliso alikeya gisivemididina amine ide aluꞋaluwada aliꞋalikana gikiveyawayawana be Keliso buye wayawaida ivaguna kamimiyami. E, yada dewa koyona faꞋina aluꞋaluwada vaita aliꞋalikana amine kamiyami nonogana Yaubada yawaida ivaguna giveleda. Yaubada yana nuwadoga keke kanawona! WaꞋita, yana nuwadoga againe kibababala wanuhagana.
Ada ide Yesu Keliso buye kaveꞋatutamoꞋaida-ma BanaꞋe buye gisivemididida, higa yawaida ivaguna giveleda be Yesu Keliso buye lobameya givehiyotoda.

Au hidede amine Yaubada ide Yesu Keliso buye gisivemididida ada givehiyotoda be higa aimo mulina tova keke ginahavaini yana nuwadoga lakahi-moꞋena ana iyaꞋiyaya ide agaideya ginayemaunena. Ide giꞋitanuwakabubuyeda be Yesu Keliso faꞋideya gihawahegena faꞋina, yana nuwadoga gavatubuga! Au keke adafaiweya kanalagani.
Wanogali! Yaubada Tauna ginuwadogemi be omi wavetumaganeni-yo ami kibababala wanuhagana. Tu keke taumiyao nuwamiya vetumagana gidayemu, au Yaubada yami vetumagana givelemi-yo wavetumaganena.

KaduꞋe keke taumiyao yami vediwe faꞋina ami kibababala wadanuhagani. Au Yaubada givetumaganavelemi-yo ami kibababala wanuhagana be keke tamo hakwadi afaiweya tauni a egana unakilakahini unagayo, “Yaku vediwe faꞋina kibababala ganuhagana.” Keke amifaiweya hidede amine wanagahe.

Atu ideꞋeyao Bana Yaubada nimana ana iyaꞋiyaya. Ide gavana anaga? Yaubada Yesu Keliso againe gibubuveꞋivaguda be higa igibagiba kanaseseyemaunedi. Mena igibagiba ma boi tuwai-lokalokana Yaubada givevaiye-vagahina be higa igibagiba amine kananauna.
MiYuda kadu yoꞋo tulidiyao Keliso againe hivesaꞋeya.

Tu omi keke miYuda tu yoꞋo tulidiyao agaidiya watubuyemu-ma yami miyami tuwaina wananuwa-nunauyena. MiYuda avewagami keke Yaubada yana yoꞋo, yana iyaꞋiyaya keke wowodiya hidatomogolohini-ma kalivai-dina tu taumeyao avewagama ide Yaubada yana iyaꞋiyaya wowodeya katomogolohina-ma kalivai-dana, higa iyaꞋiyayai-nadi kaliva wowodiyagaga gidadauda.

Yami miyami tuwaina keke nuwami ginaulu. Tuwaina keke Keliso againe wadamiyaveꞋavina, au wamiyavehaila. Kadu omi keke Yaubada yana yoꞋo miIsileli kalivai-dina, au omi tulimiyao. Boi tuwai-moꞋena Yaubada ime miIsileli yama yoꞋo givenuwadadanema be yana veyao agaimeya giseusedi, higa ama kibababala faꞋina giwonadabedabema. Tu omi tulimiyao faꞋina, Yaubada keke hidede amine gidaveyaoyemi ada au hidei babiya wamiyami koyona, aseꞋasemi ana abaluveꞋavina keke, yami Yaubada keke.

Boi tuwai-moꞋena omi tulimiyao vaita lauveya wadamiyavehaila amine. Keke Yaubada wadahalamaneni o kaꞋi yana yoꞋo agaidiya wadamiyaveꞋavina. Atu tova adamoya Keliso dayagina gimadu faꞋina, Yaubada gitaimi be omi Bana liline kadu ime Bana yana yoꞋo lilimeya wayemu-yo Yesu Keliso buye waveꞋatutamoꞋaimi.

Keliso dayagina gimadu faꞋina Bana Tauna ada tokukuya, ada au ime miYuda kadu omi tulimiyao giꞋivesaꞋeyada. Tuwaina omi tulimiyao ala hawahawatana wakwaune wamiyami, ada ama vehimeya ama hawata Mosese ime miYuda givelema-ma keke wadaꞋitaveꞋavini faꞋina kavenivenibaina. Au hidede amine kavenibaina tu Keliso yana alika againe mena abavenibaina ana ala giyawelina. Bana wowona gihawahegeni-yo mena Mosese yana vehimeya gisevehaileda-ma gidabana be higa ime miYuda kadu omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kanaveyoꞋo saꞋeyana. E, Keliso yana faisewa againe ide yoꞋo luhei ma yoꞋo saꞋeyana ivaguna katubuyemu, ada au hidede amine yada veyao gifaisewana.

Tuwaina imeꞋeyao be omiꞋiyao ma Yaubada nibaineyao tu Keliso kelose againe giꞋalika be higa ide vaita yoꞋo saꞋeyana amine giꞋivesaꞋeyada-yo Yaubada buye kanaveyao. Ada au ana kelose againe venibaina matatabuna giluveꞋalikana.

KaduꞋe Keliso giꞋela be mena veyao gifaisewana-ma moyaꞋaideyao agaideya gilumamalena. E, omi yoꞋo tulimiyao lauveya keke Yaubada liline wadamiyami-ma agaimiya veyao gilumamalena, kadu ime miYuda Yaubada liline amiyami-ma agaimeya veyao gilumamalena.

Bana Keliso yada eda gifaisewana be ada yoꞋo luhei adafaiweya Tamada matane kayemuyemu. ImeꞋeyao kadu omiꞋiyao Yaubada AluꞋaluwana saꞋeyanaga Tauna nuwahinagedeya gimimiyami-yo Tamada matane kayemuyemu.

Au hidede amine Keliso giꞋivesaꞋeyada faꞋina, omi keke tulimiyao vaita aimo hawahawala amine. Au Yaubada yana yoꞋogaga agaidiya waluku be omiꞋiyao kadu imeꞋeyao yana kaliva mahamahalideyao buye kamimiyami.
Tovetumagana moyaꞋaida vaita Yaubada yana manuwa
amine.

Ide Yaubada yana yoꞋo ma kadu vaita Yaubada yana manuwa amine. Bana Yesu Keliso Tauna manuwa ana holiliꞋabi. Ime afositolo kadu Yaubada bonana ana toꞋawatalatalaina ma manuwai-nadi ana ogola. Ada gaveyao moyaꞋaimi Yaubada yana yoꞋogaga kalivai-dina, medema yana manuwa ana huyavila againe giyogomi.

Kadu Yaubada Bana Keliso holiliꞋabi-nadi againe ide huyavila giveꞋetovefoseda be manuwa gilakalaka gilakalaka tu ide gaveyao Kaiwabu buye kaveꞋatutamoꞋaida, medema vaita yana manuwa-tafalolo mahamahalina amine kayemu.

Ada kadu omi yoꞋo tulimiyao Kaiwabu buye waveꞋatutamoꞋaimi-ma Yaubada yana manuwa againe giveꞋetohavihavimi be ide moyaꞋaideyao vaita manuwa-moꞋena amine agaideya givemanuwa. E, Yaubada AluꞋaluwana Tauna nuwahinagedeya gimimiyami faꞋina, Yaubada agaideya givemanuwa.
